verdict.rationale: The submission docs say that after initial publication, changes to a plugin's MCP server are picked up automatically and eligible updates go live after automated checks, so installed MCP-backed plugins get fixes without reinstalling. `codex plugin marketplace add` also tracks a marketplace source. However, no explicit plugin update command is documented, and there is nothing on how bundled skills or manifest changes reach users who already installed the plugin. Missing for 10: an explicit update/upgrade command, documented auto-update for skills-only or local/repo marketplace plugins, version pinning or changelog behavior, and hands-on corroboration of updates landing.

support.subject: As a developer, there is a documented update path — marketplace auto-updates or an explicit update command — so I get fixes without reinstalling from scratch

citations.quote: After initial publication, changes to your MCP server are picked up automatically, and eligible updates go live once they pass automated checks.
Use `codex plugin marketplace add` to add and track a marketplace source instead of editing `config.toml` by hand.
